g.text: Single-atom tweezer imaging: beam-path plan (ports swapped: qCMOS on R, Basler on T)
Rev. 2026-11-23: Basler relay lens L4 = 100 mm, last lens L5 = 40 mm. Schematic, not to scale. All beams at the static-objective height. 2″ optics drawn larger than 1″.
L1 = 150 mm focuses; the relay lens collimates
qCMOS (18.8 × 10.6 mm, 4.6 µm px), relay L2 = 150
Basler (7.5 × 5.6 mm, 1.85 µm px), relay L4 = 100
FoV 1 mm → 6.0 mm: 7% over the 5.6 mm height
full 1 mm FoV needs f(L5) ≤ 37 mm
